source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT  c.table_name, c.year_month
FROM audit.control_totals c
WHERE c.captured_at = (SELECT MAX(captured_at) FROM audit.control_totals)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM etl.adf_load_log l
                  WHERE l.table_name = c.table_name
                    AND l.year_month = c.year_month
                    AND l.status = 'success')
ORDER BY c.table_name, c.year_month;

sqlReaderQuery.value: SELECT last_value FROM etl.watermark WHERE table_name = '@{pipeline().parameters.table_name}'
